news.title: I never thought I’d be conceding that tech has become a fucking religion. Then I heard VPs…
news.author: LeoBurr@tiggi.es
news.snippet: I never thought I’d be conceding that tech has become a fucking religion. Then I heard VPs, grown-ass adults with budget authority over actual human beings, describe themselves as “true believers” in AI. “True believers.” Their actual God damned words. Not “I evaluated the evidence.” Not “here’s where it works and where it fails.” Belief. Faith. In a statistical text generator they could not explain if you held their bonus, wife, and LLM-parented offspring hostage. Here’s what makes my blood boil about faith in the board room, VP sphere and C-suite: a true believer needs no Real fucking evidence, so no verifiable evidence will ever change their minds unless it hits their bank account. Or over-indexed investments in AI. They mandate AI for problems it can’t solve and impact the lives of the people who could solve those problems if they were given half the empowerment they give their faith-enhanced savior tech. They cargo-cult whatever the flashiest vendors (who’ve been around less time than the Switch 2 has been out, but are now self-professed AI experts) preached at the last overhyped AI conference. And when someone walks in with data that contradicts the gospel, that person gets branded a heretic, “resistant to change”, ostracized and increasingly, much worse. The one real fucking adult in the room gets managed out while the congregation nods along. The only way to survive is to keep singing from the fuckwit hymn book and hope the worship ceremony ends soon. I’ve spent almost 30 years breaking software, hardware, security, performance, etc. for a living. Everything. Has. Fucking. Failure. Modes. EVERYTHING. My entire discipline exists because every company that ever said “trust me, it works” and wanted to bypass expert validation, real actual disciplined work, got burned to the fucking ground by it. The “dark factory” board room wet dream of AI will be more like the company burning itself to the ground in the pursuit of salvation. These high level company people aren’t leading. They’re witnessing. Your VP doesn’t understand the technology, he understands the sermon, and now your roadmap is a fucking prosperity gospel: believe harder, sacrifice your best engineers on the altar, and the ROI will surely come. It won’t. It never does. But it will impact the real lives of real people with real skills while rewarding the charlatans who keep right on fooling the idiots who are fine with being wrong because being wrong is the safe bet when the majority of the idiot US economy is betting on the same tech-as-savior. When it all goes to shit, the AI tech dudebros will just rebrand the diminished shit as “2.0.” Or their asinine “New Testament.” # AI # AIHype # TechLeadership # Quality # Enshittification

tele.title: Viettel targets 98% population 5G coverage; adds 20,000 sites in 2026
tele.title_orig: Viettel hướng tới phủ sóng 5G tới 98% dân số
tele.snippet: Deputy CEO Le Quang Hieu at MWC 2026: ~30,000 5G SA sites by end-2025; planning +20,000 in 2026 for 98% coverage.

tele.title: Vietnam eyes new 5G deals with Chinese tech firms despite US warnings
tele.snippet: Mobifone in talks with Huawei; Viettel and VNPT signed 5G supply contracts with ZTE and Huawei. Ericsson and Nokia still supply core network.

tele.title: Vietnam pursues new 5G deals with China despite US warnings
tele.title_orig: Việt Nam nhắm thỏa thuận 5G mới với Trung Quốc, bất chấp cảnh báo của Mỹ
tele.snippet: BBC Vietnamese: Mobifone negotiating with Huawei; Viettel/VNPT already signed with ZTE and Huawei for 5G equipment.

tele.title: Despite US warnings, Vietnam plans more 5G contracts with Chinese vendors
tele.title_orig: 不顾美国警告 越南拟与中企签更多5G网络合约
tele.snippet: Zaobao: Mobifone tender favors Chinese firms; Huawei 5G gear seen near US Consulate in HCMC; follows Viettel/VNPT ZTE/Huawei deals.

tele.title: Viettel to trial 6G in 2028 with Qualcomm strategic alliance
tele.title_orig: Viettel sẽ thử nghiệm 6G vào năm 2028
tele.snippet: MWC 2026: Viettel joins Qualcomm 6G alliance; commercial 6G target from 2029; co-develop premium AI smartphones.

tele.title: Cambodia 5G trial: Cellcard leads download speeds in early Ookla tests
tele.title_orig: អ៊ីនធើណិត 5G សាកល្បងជំហានដំបូងនៅកម្ពុជា
tele.snippet: AMS Khmer: Ookla trial shows Cellcard 548 Mbps, Smart 336 Mbps, Metfone 218 Mbps; 1,500+ 5G sites by March 2026.

tele.title: 1,500 5G base stations deployed in Cambodia's 5G race so far
tele.snippet: Smart Axiata 674, Metfone (Viettel) 531, Cellcard 289 stations. Ministry accelerating mobile and FWA rollout.

tele.title: Vietnam 5G median speed tops 500 Mbps for the first time; Viettel leads at 617 Mbps
tele.title_orig: Mạng 5G Việt Nam lần đầu vượt 500 Mbps
tele.snippet: VNNIC i-Speed Jan 2026: national 5G median 594.81 Mbps; Viettel 617 Mbps vs VNPT 311 Mbps and MobiFone 188 Mbps.

tele.title: Cambodia launches 5G as all three mobile operators switch on networks
tele.snippet: Cellcard, Metfone and Smart launched 5G from Jan 2026. Phased rollout from Phnom Penh and 14 provinces.

tele.title: Vietnam 5G mass deployment opens platform for app developers
tele.title_orig: 越南5G大规模部署：为应用程序开发搭建新平台
tele.snippet: VietnamPlus Chinese: Viettel 30,000 5G sites, 90% outdoor coverage; Huawei expert praises fast 5G e-commerce adoption.

tele.title: Huawei and ZTE win 5G contracts in Vietnam; Ericsson and Nokia retain core
tele.title_orig: 消息称华为中兴在越南斩获5G合同
tele.snippet: C114: Huawei $23M consortium deal; ZTE $20M+ antenna contracts; Nordic vendors on core; ~11,000 5G sites cover 26% population.
